title: Chapter 04 promises music the runtime cannot supply
finding: The teenage-years introduction promises music, while the active public data layer has no music source. This is a copy-versus-data defect, not evidence that song data exists.

evidence.detail: The chapter 04 introduction includes music among the experiences it promises.
The active source registry contains no public runtime music dataset.

proposedAction: Owner chooses whether to narrow the chapter introduction now or add verified, cohort-relevant music data through the product's own process later.
